title: ManageEngine NetFlow Analyzer CReportPDFServlet schFilePath Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose files on vulnerable installations of ManageEngine NetFlow Analyzer. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of input to the CReportPDFServlet servlet. The issue lies in the failure to perform any validation of the input filename. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to disclose files from the system.
